import.error: Something went wrong while importing notebook.

export.title: Export
export.error: Something went wrong while exporting notebook.

provider.label: AI provider
provider.description: Select the AI provider to use.

ruler.label: Ruler
ruler.description: Render vertical ruler after a certain number of monospace characters.

showLineNumbers.label: Show line numbers
showLineNumbers.description: Controls whether to show line numbers for search results.

fontSize.label: Font Size
fontSize.description: Controls the font size in pixels.

fontLigatures.label: Font Ligatures
fontLigatures.description: Configures font ligatures or font features.

formatOnPaste.label: Format on paste
formatOnPaste.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically format the pasted content.

formatOnType.label: Format on type
formatOnType.description: Controls whether the editor should automatically format the line after typing.

tabSize.label: Tab Size
tabSize.description: The number of spaces a tab is equal to.

printWidth.label: Print width
printWidth.description: Fit code within this line limit.

semi.label: Semi
semi.description: Whether to use semicolons at the end of every line.

singleQuote.label: Single quote
singleQuote.description: Use single instead of double quotes.

jsxSingleQuote.label: JSX single quote
jsxSingleQuote.description: Use single instead of double quotes in JSX.

trailingComma.label: Trailing comma
trailingComma.description: Controls the printing of trailing commas wherever possible.

arrowParens.label: Arrow Parens
arrowParens.description: Include parentheses around a sole arrow function parameter.

bracketSpacing.label: Bracket spacing
bracketSpacing.description: Controls the printing of spaces inside object literals.

bracketSameLine.label: Bracket same liine
bracketSameLine.description: Put the '>' of a multi-line HTML (HTML, JSX, Vue, Angular) element at the end of the last line instead of being alone on the next line (does not apply to self closing elements).

endOfLine.label: End of line
endOfLine.description: Specify the end of line used by prettier.

quoteProps.label: Quote props
quoteProps.description: Change when properties in objects are quoted.

singleAttributePerLine.label: Single attribute per line
singleAttributePerLine.description: Enforces single attribute per line in HTML, JSX, Vue and Angular.
